name: astrok
description: Astro, Solid 2 and OKF framework with optional trusted hypermedia

scripts.validate:okf: node scripts/validate-okf.mjs knowledge && node scripts/validate-okf.mjs examples/graph/knowledge
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @astrok/example-workspace
scripts.verify: npm run build:packages && npm test && npm run check && npm run build:docs && npm run test:docs:browser && npm run verify:astrok
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @astrok/theme && npm run build --workspace @astrok/okf && npm run build --workspace @astrok/astro && npm run build --workspace @astrok/runtime
scripts.build:example: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @astrok/example-workspace
scripts.verify:astrok: npm run validate:okf && node scripts/validate-okf.mjs examples/workspace/knowledge && npm run build:packages && npm run test:runtime && node --test tests/packages.test.mjs && npm run check --workspace @astrok/example-workspace && npm run build --workspace @astrok/example-workspace && npm run test:astrok:browser && npm run verify:packages
